title: How to Plan a Meshtastic Node for Rural Property
seo_title: Meshtastic Node Setup Ontario | Placement, Power, Enclosure
description: Plan a Meshtastic node setup in Ontario: pick the antenna spot, size winter power, choose a weatherproof enclosure and test before you mount it for good.
excerpt: A reliable Meshtastic node depends on antenna placement, winter power and a weather-ready enclosure more than on settings. Plan those three first, then test before mounting.
